## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the strand orientation of a feature on a double-stranded sequence; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting strand for stranded features (it changes the read direction).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:sequenceStrand`](gmeow-sequenceStrand.md) to a [`gmeow:StrandOrientation`](../classes/gmeow-StrandOrientation.md) individual.
